verdicts.rationale: weaviate_010 claims HTTP 500 status for validation errors is a bug. Source code analysis CONFIRMS this is a genuine defect: validateBatchDelete() correctly detects empty match.where and empty match.class clauses but returns plain errors.New() instead of NewErrInvalidUserInput(). This causes the REST handler to map them to HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 422. The source comment at lines 155-160 explicitly acknowledges this bug: 'otherwise the REST handler maps the parse/validation failure to a 500 instead of a 422'. This matches developer cognition blindspot indicator for HTTP status-code semantics. The maintainer has repeatedly fixed similar issues (500→422 PR 12049, 500→404 PR 12040, batch REST handler fixes PR 11878). While validation logic works correctly, the HTTP status classification is wrong and should return 422 (Unprocessable Entity) for client-side detectable errors. Verdict: CONFIRMED as HTTP status semantics bug.
